desc: Strike industries has been pushing the boundaries of innovation with their line of products adding functionality and versatility. Their new LINK Hand stop is no different constructed with Strike Industries High Impact Polymer this hand stop uses Strike Industries unique SI Link attachment system meaning you don't have to choose between KeyMod or M-LOK. For an easier time managing the cable around your lights laser or other accessories this hand stop also comes with recessed channels that can route the wires in a variety of configurations. And with a textured surface on either side and a slight angle that can be biased forward or rearward this hand stop is easy to hold on to or use as an impromptu barricade stop. So keep a hold on you rifle or pistol with the Strike Industries LINK Hand Stop.
